label: Narion
description: The client. Asks for help on behalf of the party through the Audience interface. At the den, the guard receives the request.
imageAlt: Portrait of Narion, who speaks for the party

fields.label: contact: Audience
fields.description: Narion’s point of contact. At the den, it is the guard.

methods.label: askForCure()
methods.description: Calls contact.requestHelp(request) to ask for the antidote. Narion can include Orven’s letter.

label: Audience
description: The shared way to ask for help. Both the guard and the Elder implement it.

methods.label: requestHelp(request) · contract
methods.description: Receives the party’s request and any letter they send with it, then returns a reply.

label: DenGuardProxy
description: The protection proxy. Speaks for the Elder and decides which requests reach her.
imageAlt: The armored guard stands alone in the cave entrance

fields.label: elder: TishKarrElder
fields.description: The Elder who receives approved requests.

methods.label: requestHelp(request) · guard
methods.description: Checks the request. If it passes, calls elder.requestHelp(request) and passes back the reply. Otherwise, returns a refusal.

methods.label: canPass(request)
methods.description: Checks that Narion brought a letter and compares its signature and wax seal with one of Orven’s old letters.

label: TishKarrElder
description: The real subject. Has the antidote and decides whether to share it when a request reaches her.
imageAlt: Three Tish-Karr creatures wait inside the den

methods.label: requestHelp(request) · Elder
methods.description: Hears the request and decides what reply or help to offer.
